title: email.read input
description: Bounded single-message read for the email.read operation. R0: the request reads one message from the mailbox of the explicitly named account through the governed life adapter under a scoped opaque credential lease and produces no side effects. The `account` selector names one configured life account and travels with every request; credential material never travels in arguments. The message identifier is bounded at 128 characters, exactly the adapter's enforced bound. An unknown account, missing credentials, or an unreachable service is a typed unavailable outcome, never an empty success.
